payload.focus: Sprint retrospective: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This short sprint retro directly maps to the Sprint 4 retro sample document and its witness-depth positions: Zephyr integration as key unlock (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock), 23-point velocity (Obs_TinaVelocity), and the thesis-proven claim (Position_Sprint4ThesisProven). I expanded the two core narratives (DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, DecisionsEvaporate) and the AntiSlackPositioning narrative because the async decision widget is the product embodiment of all three. I also surfaced the anti-pattern position, core feature position, webhook architecture, pricing evolution ($12→$15), product category, target market, next-sprint context-preservation focus, and the Zephyr rate-limit resolution observation — all positions this retro could answer, extend, or brush against. The two style observations (metric-anchored claims, direct-quote format) are included so the passes can bind the document's rhetorical patterns. No areas were deliberately excluded; the graph is small and every node plausibly overlaps this document.
